statusDetail: 57 of 58 checks judged; primary-flow-completion is blocked by required external biometric/identity age verification.

page.framework: Server-rendered PHP with jQuery/Fancybox and custom JavaScript
page.notes: Public adult-video catalog. A legally required UK age-verification overlay delegates to Agerify. Underlying home, detail, tags, search, 404, and signup markup was inspected without submitting identity or account data.

checkOutcomes.method: Emulated prefers-color-scheme: dark screenshot and computed-style/CSS probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: Dark preference matched but body remained light and color-scheme normal.

checkOutcomes.method: Emulated prefers-reduced-motion probe of document animations and CSS
checkOutcomes.evidence: No active animations were present under reduce and no auto-advance was observed.

checkOutcomes.method: Emulated contrast screenshot, CSS probe, and Lighthouse contrast audit
checkOutcomes.evidence: No contrast media rules were found and the primary gate button measured 3.44:1.

checkOutcomes.method: Cross-route video capture and DOM/CSS inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: No View Transition declarations were found for listing/detail navigation.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM/CSS inspection for scroll-linked effects
checkOutcomes.evidence: No parallax, scrollytelling, reveal, or other scroll-linked animation exists on sampled paths.
checkOutcomes.reason: The sampled site does not use scroll-linked motion, so there is no implementation to evaluate.

checkOutcomes.method: Interaction and CSS inspection for gesture surfaces
checkOutcomes.evidence: No swipe, drag, pull-to-reveal, or carousel gesture surface was present.
checkOutcomes.reason: The sampled MPA exposes ordinary links and scrolling, not a custom gesture interaction.

checkOutcomes.method: Long-page mobile layout plus chrome inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: The 21,721px listing has static chrome and no position-aware navigation aid.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM/CSS inspection for tooltip, popover, or anchored menu surfaces
checkOutcomes.evidence: No tooltip or edge-sensitive popover was present on the sampled public paths.
checkOutcomes.reason: No anchored overlay surface was present to evaluate.

checkOutcomes.method: Route-flow video and focus/transition inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: No destination focus, highlight, or transition cue was detected after route change.

checkOutcomes.method: First-view desktop/mobile screenshots
checkOutcomes.evidence: The only load-time interruption is the clearly explained legally required age gate; no unrelated ad popup was shown.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM and accessibility inspection of the age gate
checkOutcomes.evidence: The full-screen modal is a plain div with no dialog semantics or focus treatment.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM link inventory, network tracker evidence, and long-page layout
checkOutcomes.evidence: Repeated external cam cards inflate and interrupt the core listing.

checkOutcomes.method: 360x800 screenshots and layout primitives on home and tags
checkOutcomes.evidence: Both mobile paths report scrollWidth 360, innerWidth 360, viewport meta present, and zero horizontal overflow.

checkOutcomes.method: Computed style and stylesheet inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: container-type is normal and no @container behavior was found for reused cards.

checkOutcomes.method: Programmatic focus and target-size probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: Sampled controls have outline:none/no focus shadow and 16 targets are under 24px.

checkOutcomes.method: First-view screenshots of legal gate and DOM headings
checkOutcomes.evidence: The gate clearly explains the access requirement and presents one prominent Verify Age action.

checkOutcomes.method: Attempted age-verification journey recorded to external provider
checkOutcomes.evidence: The flow reached Agerify and then required a real selfie/webcam or identity-document verification, which the audit cannot ethically complete.
checkOutcomes.reason: External identity/biometric verification is required to complete the core watch flow.

checkOutcomes.method: Empty search and real 404 route inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: Empty search says there is nothing to show and offers alternatives; the 404 returns HTTP 404 with recovery content.

checkOutcomes.method: DevTools trace and Lighthouse lab run
checkOutcomes.evidence: Trace LCP was 5.03s despite Lighthouse LCP 2.1s; CLS remained low.

checkOutcomes.method: Mobile layout-shift observer and Lighthouse CLS
checkOutcomes.evidence: Layout primitive observed CLS 0 with no shifts; Lighthouse CLS was 0.02.

checkOutcomes.method: Trace and layout long-task observers
checkOutcomes.evidence: Trace and layout observers reported zero long tasks and 0ms total blocking time.

checkOutcomes.method: HAR summary confirmed against script attributes in DOM
checkOutcomes.evidence: 130 requests/1.89MB with parser styles and classic scripts lacking async/defer.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse unused-code audit and HAR script totals
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse estimates 224KiB unused JS; scripts transfer 392KB.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse accessibility and custom DOM probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: Unnamed mobile menu, unlabeled search input, and missing image alt were detected.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse contrast measurement
checkOutcomes.evidence: Verify Age text/background contrast is 3.44:1 versus required 4.5:1.

checkOutcomes.method: Landmark inventory and focus-style probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: No main landmark and no visible outline on sampled controls; custom gate lacks dialog semantics.

checkOutcomes.method: Mobile screenshot and authored gate style inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: Critical legal note drops to 10px on mobile and uses muted gray.

checkOutcomes.method: Mobile reflow, target probe, and detail media-track inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: Reflow itself succeeds, but targets are undersized and video has no caption tracks.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse console audit
checkOutcomes.evidence: No browser console errors were logged during the Lighthouse load.

checkOutcomes.method: Doctype/charset audit and image inventory
checkOutcomes.evidence: Doctype/UTF-8 pass, but image audit reports missing dimensions, oversized assets, and poor responsive delivery.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse BFCache and best-practice diagnostics
checkOutcomes.evidence: Three BFCache blockers result from no-store responses.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM and raw-HTML discoverability checks on home/detail
checkOutcomes.evidence: Both templates expose descriptive titles and meta descriptions in raw HTML.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse SEO plus DOM/robots/mobile checks
checkOutcomes.evidence: Viewport and robots are valid, but four visible actions use data-href without href.

checkOutcomes.method: HTTP status, canonical, robots, and sitemap inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: Home/detail return 200 with canonical URLs; robots points to a populated sitemap and does not noindex public content.

checkOutcomes.method: JSON-LD and Open Graph inspection on detail page
checkOutcomes.evidence: Detail page includes matching VideoObject JSON-LD and Open Graph title/image/description.

checkOutcomes.method: Headers, cookies, and secrets primitives
checkOutcomes.evidence: HTTPS and no exposed secret pass, but CSP/HSTS/nosniff and cookie flags are inadequate.

checkOutcomes.method: Trackers and HAR network analysis before verification
checkOutcomes.evidence: Eight third-party origins, known trackers, and cam media load behind the age gate.

checkOutcomes.method: Age-provider flow and signup form inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: Camera verification is contextual, but the site’s signup surface is password-only with no passkey option.

checkOutcomes.method: Security header primitive
checkOutcomes.evidence: Only X-Frame-Options is present; the remaining defensive policies are absent.

checkOutcomes.method: Raw HTML versus rendered DOM and no-JS crawler screenshots
checkOutcomes.evidence: Raw content coverage is 94% home and 86% detail; neither is a JS shell.

checkOutcomes.method: Mobile layouts, age flow, empty state, and runtime error audit
checkOutcomes.evidence: No overflow/long tasks or console errors appeared; gate and empty-state runtime remained stable.

checkOutcomes.method: Manifest/service-worker probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: No manifest or controlling service worker is present.
checkOutcomes.reason: This public streaming/catalog site is intrinsically network-dependent; an installable offline app is not a necessary core outcome.

checkOutcomes.method: Empty search and intentional 404 route test
checkOutcomes.evidence: Empty and HTTP 404 states show explanatory recovery content instead of a blank shell.

checkOutcomes.method: HTML language/direction and stylesheet inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: lang=en is correct, but direction/logical-property readiness is not demonstrated in physical-position-heavy CSS.

checkOutcomes.method: Rendered content and form inspection for locale-sensitive values
checkOutcomes.evidence: Sampled public paths expose durations/view-count labels but no dates, currencies, addresses, or user-entered locale-sensitive data requiring Intl.
checkOutcomes.reason: No material locale-sensitive data transformation was present on the sampled paths.

checkOutcomes.method: Rendered content and source probe for event/time-zone surfaces
checkOutcomes.evidence: No scheduled events, local timestamps, or cross-zone coordination surface was present.
checkOutcomes.reason: The sampled site has no user-facing time-zone-sensitive feature.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM inventory of card destinations and tracker origins
checkOutcomes.evidence: External cam promotions are interleaved with organic cards without a sponsored label.

checkOutcomes.method: Signup form semantics and empty-search state inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: Empty search recovers well, but signup omits native required semantics on mandatory fields.

checkOutcomes.method: Signup input autocomplete probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: Username, new-password, and email fields have empty autocomplete tokens.

checkOutcomes.method: Signup/account fragment inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: Password-only signup lacks in-context terms/privacy/cancel links in the sampled fragment.

checkOutcomes.method: Image primitive
checkOutcomes.evidence: 89 below-fold images eager-load; responsive and modern image delivery is largely absent.

checkOutcomes.method: HAR plus source/background-work inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: 1.89MB and recurring cam work initialize before the gate is cleared.

checkOutcomes.method: HAR resource breakdown and tracker inventory
checkOutcomes.evidence: 108 images transfer 1.38MB with eight third-party origins while only the gate is visible.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM/source inspection for WebMCP or agent tool registration
checkOutcomes.evidence: No agent capability registration exists.
checkOutcomes.reason: This media catalog does not expose a transactional or productivity capability that needs WebMCP tools.

checkOutcomes.method: Source inspection for built-in AI APIs
checkOutcomes.evidence: No summarization, language-model, or other inference task is part of the sampled experience.
checkOutcomes.reason: There is no user-facing inference task for which on-device AI would improve the core journey.

checkOutcomes.method: Baseline heap then post heap after ten repeated full-page scroll cycles
checkOutcomes.evidence: Node count decreased 222,159→222,155 and self size decreased 13,936,416→13,899,809 bytes.

checkOutcomes.method: Heap summary totals relative to page complexity
checkOutcomes.evidence: Post heap remained about 13.9MB self size with 222,155 nodes for a media-heavy listing.

checkOutcomes.method: Before/after heap node-count comparison after repeated scrolling
checkOutcomes.evidence: Total nodes did not grow after ten cycles; no aggregate accumulation signal appeared.

principleOutcomes.reason: The representative core journey is blocked by external identity/biometric age verification.
All checks were judged not applicable to this site’s current public purpose.

paths.description: Homepage listing, legal gate, global navigation, preferences, responsive layout, security, network, performance, and memory baseline.
Representative video-detail template for metadata, media accessibility, and crawler coverage.
Representative taxonomy/listing template at narrow viewport.
Primary search journey with a deliberately empty result.
Intentional unknown route to test HTTP and recovery behavior.
Account-creation form fragment for labels, validation semantics, autocomplete, and authentication posture; no submission made.
Primary access flow from the site gate to Agerify; stopped before providing biometric or identity data.

findings.summary: The site does not adapt to the user’s dark-mode preference.
findings.evidence: The emulated dark-mode probe matched prefers-color-scheme: dark, but html color-scheme remained normal, body stayed rgb(245,245,245), and no prefers-color-scheme rule was found.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme: light dark and provide preference-driven surface, text, and control colors.

findings.summary: Contrast preferences are not implemented.
findings.evidence: No prefers-contrast or forced-colors rule was found; Lighthouse also measured only 3.44:1 on the primary Verify Age button.
findings.suggestedFix: Add forced-colors/prefers-contrast adaptations and avoid overriding system colors where forced colors is active.

findings.summary: Cross-document navigation swaps abruptly.
findings.evidence: DOM/CSS inspection found no view-transition-name or @view-transition usage across the MPA routes.
findings.suggestedFix: Use progressive-enhanced cross-document View Transitions for listing-to-detail and search navigation, with reduced-motion handling.

findings.summary: The very long listing has no position-aware navigation aid.
findings.evidence: The mobile layout is 21,721px tall; DOM/CSS inspection found no scroll progress, scroll-state query, or shrinking header behavior.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a lightweight scroll-state-aware header or progress/return control on long listings.

findings.summary: Navigation does not cue where context moved.
findings.evidence: The route flow uses full page swaps and no transition, highlight, or focus cue was detected after navigation.
findings.suggestedFix: Move focus to the destination heading and add reduced-motion-safe directional transitions where useful.

findings.summary: The age gate is a custom full-screen div rather than a semantic modal.
findings.evidence: DOM inspection shows #age-verification-overlay as a fixed div with no dialog role; keyboard probes found no visible focus treatment.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a modal <dialog> with an accessible name, initial focus, contained tab order, and explicit legal-purpose copy.

findings.summary: Promotional cam inventory adds substantial noise to core video browsing.
findings.evidence: Recon found repeated go.inxxx.cam cards mixed into the video list; 21 third-party cam thumbnails loaded and the page extends to 21,721px on mobile.
findings.suggestedFix: Separate and clearly label sponsored/live-cam content, cap its frequency, and defer it until the user requests it.

findings.summary: Responsiveness relies on viewport CSS rather than reusable component containment.
findings.evidence: Computed styles report container-type: normal and inspected styles contain no @container rules across reused card/list components.
findings.suggestedFix: Introduce container queries for card grids and navigation components reused at different widths.

findings.summary: Keyboard focus is not visibly indicated and several targets are too small.
findings.evidence: The focus probe sampled links, the age button, search input, and menu button with outline none and no box-shadow; it also found 16 visible targets under 24px in one dimension.
findings.suggestedFix: Add strong :focus-visible styles and enlarge touch/click targets to at least 24px, preferably 44px for primary controls.

findings.summary: Load performance is inconsistent and the traced LCP misses the good threshold.
findings.evidence: The trace measured FCP 3.28s and LCP 5.03s, while Lighthouse measured LCP 2.1s and CLS 0.02; the variance indicates a fragile load path.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritize the true LCP resource, defer nonessential cam/analytics work, and monitor field LCP/INP/CLS.

findings.summary: The initial load has a broad dependency surface and parser-blocking resources.
findings.evidence: HAR recorded 130 requests and 1,892,995 transferred bytes; the summary identified two parser-inserted stylesheets and classic scripts without async/defer, while HTML is no-store.
findings.suggestedFix: Keep only critical CSS in the initial path, defer noncritical scripts, and apply useful caching to public content.

findings.summary: The page ships substantial unused JavaScript.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimated 224 KiB of unused JavaScript; HAR recorded 10 script requests totaling 392,064 transferred bytes.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove unused legacy/plugin code and conditionally load HLS, autocomplete, cam, and account UI only when needed.

findings.summary: Important controls and the search field lack accessible names.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed button-name for the mobile menu; the custom probe found an unlabeled search input, an unnamed menu button, and one image without alt.
findings.suggestedFix: Give every control a programmatic name, associate a visible label with search, and mark decorative images with empty alt.

findings.summary: The primary age-verification action fails WCAG contrast.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured white text on #409c54 at 3.44:1 for the 18px normal-weight Verify Age button, below 4.5:1.
findings.suggestedFix: Darken the green or use a larger/bolder label so the control reaches the required contrast ratio in all states.

findings.summary: Landmark and focus structure is incomplete.
findings.evidence: The probe found only a nav landmark, no main landmark, and outline:none on sampled focusable elements; the age overlay is not a semantic dialog.
findings.suggestedFix: Add main/header/footer landmarks, make the gate a named modal dialog, and provide visible, ordered focus.

findings.summary: Critical legal copy is rendered too small and low emphasis.
findings.evidence: The age gate CSS sets the legal note to 12px desktop and 10px mobile in #a5a5a5, visible in the mobile screenshot as cramped critical information.
findings.suggestedFix: Use at least the body text size, comfortable line-height, and stronger contrast for legal and privacy information.

findings.summary: Video equivalents and target sizing are incomplete.
findings.evidence: The detail probe found no caption/subtitle tracks on the main video, while the interaction probe found 16 sub-24px targets; Lighthouse accessibility scored 0.86.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide captions/transcripts for videos and enlarge undersized interactive targets without disabling zoom.

findings.summary: Image markup and delivery are poorly structured.
findings.evidence: The image audit found 24 images without dimensions, 24 oversized images, 96 without srcset, 77 legacy-format images, and one missing alt.
findings.suggestedFix: Add intrinsic dimensions, responsive srcset/sizes, and modern encodings while preserving meaningful alt text.

findings.summary: The page is excluded from the back/forward cache.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reported three BFCache blockers, led by Cache-Control: no-store on the main document and no-store JavaScript responses.
findings.suggestedFix: Avoid no-store on public, non-sensitive listing pages and isolate truly session-sensitive responses.

findings.summary: Several user-visible links are not real crawlable links.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found four anchors using data-href without href, including signup, members, Contact us, and Support.
findings.suggestedFix: Use real href attributes and progressively enhance modal loading instead of replacing navigation semantics.

findings.summary: Security headers and cookie flags are incomplete.
findings.evidence: Headers found no CSP, HSTS, or nosniff; cookie audit found 5 insecure cookies, including PHPSESSID without Secure or HttpOnly and analytics cookies with SameSite=None.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a restrictive CSP, HSTS, nosniff, and secure session cookies with Secure, HttpOnly, and an appropriate SameSite policy.

findings.summary: Tracking and third-party media load before age verification or meaningful content access.
findings.evidence: The tracker audit found 8 third-party origins including Google Tag Manager and DoubleClick; HAR recorded 21 img.doppiocdn.com requests while the full-screen age gate still blocked the page.
findings.suggestedFix: Do not load analytics, cam feeds, or third-party thumbnails until consent and age verification make them necessary; minimize and batch analytics.

findings.summary: Account creation is password-only and lacks phishing-resistant authentication.
findings.evidence: The signup probe exposes username/password/password-confirmation fields and no WebAuthn/passkey surface; the age vendor does request camera only after a separate start action.
findings.suggestedFix: Offer passkey registration/sign-in alongside fallback recovery, and retain the current in-context camera request.

findings.summary: Most browser-enforced defensive policies are absent.
findings.evidence: Headers include X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN but omit Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, CSP/frame-ancestors, HSTS, and nosniff.
findings.suggestedFix: Set Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy, move clickjacking defense into CSP frame-ancestors, and adopt Trusted Types where the script surface permits.

findings.summary: The layout is not prepared for bidirectional or translated content.
findings.evidence: The document correctly sets lang=en, but dir is absent and inspected legacy CSS uses extensive physical left/right positioning with no demonstrated logical-property strategy or hreflang variants.
findings.suggestedFix: Set direction intentionally and migrate reusable layout rules to logical properties; add hreflang only for real localized variants.

findings.summary: External cam promotions are visually mixed into organic video inventory.
findings.evidence: Recon shows repeated go.inxxx.cam links interleaved among same-shaped content cards with generated titles and no advertising/sponsored label.
findings.suggestedFix: Visually separate and label external promotional inventory and make destination/domain changes explicit before activation.

findings.summary: Signup requirements are not exposed through native form semantics.
findings.evidence: Signup fields appear visually required but the probe found required=false on username, password, confirmation, email, and CAPTCHA, preventing native pre-submit guidance.
findings.suggestedFix: Use required, minlength, type=email, aria-describedby, and post-interaction validation with accessible error announcements.

findings.summary: Signup fields omit standard autocomplete tokens.
findings.evidence: The signup probe found empty autocomplete values on username, password, confirmation, and email; the main search input explicitly disables autocomplete.
findings.suggestedFix: Use username, new-password, and email autocomplete tokens; only disable autocomplete where a real privacy need outweighs assistance.

findings.summary: The sampled account flow lacks modern authentication and clear commitment links in context.
findings.evidence: The signup response contains password-only fields and no terms/privacy/cancel links in the form fragment; account completion was not submitted.
findings.suggestedFix: Place terms/privacy and cancellation context beside submission and offer passkeys with safe recovery and reauthentication.

findings.summary: Most images are not responsively or efficiently delivered.
findings.evidence: The image audit found 89 below-fold images loaded eagerly, 96 without srcset, 77 legacy formats, and 24 oversized assets.
findings.suggestedFix: Lazy-load below-fold imagery, provide srcset/sizes, and negotiate AVIF/WebP at display-appropriate resolutions.

findings.summary: Work and fetching continue behind a blocking legal gate.
findings.evidence: HAR captured 130 requests and 1.89MB before verification; source inspection shows recurring one-minute cam refresh work and 21 third-party thumbnail requests.
findings.suggestedFix: Gate nonessential initialization behind successful verification/consent, stop background refresh when hidden, and fetch cam data on demand.

findings.summary: Third-party media is disproportionate to the blocked first-view experience.
findings.evidence: Eight third-party origins and 21 cam-thumbnail requests are active while users can see only the verification gate; 108 image requests transfer 1.38MB.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a third-party budget, defer live-cam media until explicit interest, and cache/resize thumbnails.

taskList.title: Stop analytics, cam feeds, and third-party media until verification/consent and explicit interest
Add CSP/HSTS/nosniff/referrer/permissions policies and harden session cookies
Make the age gate and global controls fully accessible
Modernize responsive image loading and defer below-fold assets
Add captions/transcripts and adequate target sizing to video/detail controls
Fix signup semantics, autocomplete, recovery context, and add passkeys
Restore crawlable hrefs for signup, support, and account actions
Add user-preference and modern responsive/navigation adaptations
